content.thinking: I have no network access, so I'll have to label the data myself or hand it off to subagents. The data looks like MNLI, with neutral making up about a third. I'll split it into chunks of roughly 110 lines and send them to 8 workers, though that still amounts to the same model doing the labeling.

import os
os.makedirs('/work/ch',exist_ok=True)
n=8;k=-(-len(L)//n)
for i in range(n):
    open(f'/work/ch/in{i}.txt','w').write('\n'.join(f"{j}\t{l.split(' || Instance: ',1)[1]}" for j,l in enumerate(L[i*k:(i+1)*k])))
hs=[await rlm.spawn(f"Read /work/ch/in{i}.txt: each line is 'idx<TAB>premise -> hypothesis'.
